sar.narrative: On 2016-11-27, card C10434-K1 belonging to customer C10434 was used for a 1000.03 USD online transaction 3506725 in billing region 469.0, country 87.0. The product code was R. Episode reconstruction identified 3 related transaction(s) totaling 1200.10 USD from 2016-11-27 to 2016-12-06. Graph neighborhood review found this activity inconsistent with the cardholder's established pattern or linked it to a shared origin, email cluster, or mixed-channel takeover. Online purchase 3506725 used a device not seen on this card, shortly after in-person activity. That mixed-channel shift is treated as stolen credentials rather than a stolen card number alone. The investigation treated the purchase as unauthorized. Connected cards recommended for monitoring: C02354-K2, C07987-K2. The flagged card is recommended for restriction pending reissue. Total unauthorized amount: 1200.10 USD. This report is filed so a regulator can review the episode on its own.
